what: The walk runner's alone re-run of a failed walk runs the whole walk suite, so the defect/flake verdict the ready gate reads is wrong and two failures pass the walks timeout (walks/run_walks.py); pr-1-review findings: walks-and-retirement B1

The Summary's Latest line can name an older check's fields: _latest takes moves[0] after a high-signal-first sort (webapp/api_summary.py); its test's fixture had no high-signal field; findings: server-and-domain 1

A finished check rebuilds the tab: Summary jumps to This week while the address says month, custom dates lost; New matches drops ticks, pending dismiss and View dismissed (app.js refresh, summary.js, new_matches.js); findings: client-shell 1, seams 1

A slow answer for a trial, queue, All trials or Summary already left draws over the page the analyst moved to; ticket 16 fixed this for Find trials only (app.js route passes no alive); findings: client-shell 2
The sidebar loses aria-current and its highlight after Rename, New watchlist, Remove and Undo (app.js reviewchange redraws with null); findings: client-shell 5

A failed read of a check's state shows an empty error box (app.js el takes no children) and one failed poll leaves Check for updates refused with a blank status (check.js poll has no catch); findings: client-shell 3 and 4
Adding from New matches leaves the header at 0 trials monitored and Check for new matches (check.js captures the overview at mount); findings: seams 2

Trial details preset Add to the first watchlist, not the one the analyst came from, so a trial is added to the wrong list; Back from a New matches card goes to Find trials (registry_trial.js); findings: discovery-and-export S1

Add by NCT ID: a failed add after a good lookup clears the ID and shows the failure in the success banner with an Open link (add_by_id.js; same shape in registry_trial.js); findings: discovery-and-export S3
A saved search with two lead sponsor types is narrowed to the first on Edit search, and Replace saved search would store it (find.js single select); findings: seams 3

An inverted start-date window is shown as a registry failure with a Retry that cannot succeed (find.js ignores err.kind), and the server picks nothing_asked or bad_dates by matching message text (api_search, api_saved_search, monitor._refuse_unanswerable); findings: seams 4, server-and-domain 4

A trial added while its watchlist is deleted gets an orphan list_members row and a 200 added reply (api_membership.add_trials writes after the unlocked fetch without re-reading the list); findings: discovery-and-export S2, server-and-domain 8
A check still fetches, marks checked and records changes for a trial removed (or a watchlist deleted) while it runs (api_checks._work uses the steps fixed at start); findings: server-and-domain 7
The exported CSV has no byte-order mark, so Excel shows the em dash for every empty value and accented title characters garbled (briefing.as_csv); findings: discovery-and-export S4

The Summary walk asserts (trials, changes) == (2, changes), a value compared with itself, and its seed leans on the wall clock at week and month boundaries (walks/test_summary_walk.py); findings: client-shell 10, walks-and-retirement N3
The acceptance walk measures horizontal scroll only at its nine screenshots and the end, though its box claims every step (Guards.measure via Walk.shot); findings: walks-and-retirement S1
The acceptance walk checks only the controls it aimed at, not the Tab stops it passed, though its box claims every control reached (Keys.focus); findings: walks-and-retirement S2
